definitions.gloss: liquid India ink, bottled sumi ink
definitions.explanation: Pre-made liquid ink used for calligraphy (書道) and ink painting (水墨画). A convenient alternative to grinding an ink stick on an inkstone.

examples.japanese: {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}を{筆|ふで}につけた。
examples.english: I dipped the brush in the ink.

examples.japanese: {書道|しょどう}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{墨汁|ぼくじゅう}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: We use liquid ink in calligraphy class.

examples.japanese: {服|ふく}に{墨汁|ぼくじゅう}がついてしまい、{洗|あら}っても{落|お}ちなかった。
examples.english: I got ink on my clothes and it wouldn't come out even after washing.

notes:
CULTURE:
In Japanese schools, students use {墨汁|ぼくじゅう} in {書道|しょどう} (calligraphy) class. Traditionally, ink was prepared by grinding an {墨|すみ} (ink stick) on a {硯|すずり} (inkstone) with water, but bottled {墨汁|ぼくじゅう} is more convenient and widely used today.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}をつける: to apply ink
- {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}がこぼれる: the ink spills
- {墨汁|ぼくじゅう}のしみ: an ink stain
